summary: The original diff corrects insert accepting indices beyond len but below capacity, rather than rejecting valid append positions as the imported description claims. Inserting at index 1 into an empty vector reaches len - index, causing subtraction overflow in debug builds and potentially invalid memory copying otherwise. The fix returns Some(element) without modifying the vector when index exceeds len or equals capacity. The fix-added test_insert_out_of_bounds in tests/tests.rs exercises this case. No tests were run.
